change: Replaced the Local AI provider's standalone Connector synthesis toggle with one unified 'Cloud-assisted features' setting (off by default, migrating an existing choice forward): it now also gates proactive assistants and live notes (task/memory/suggestion/insight extraction from screen and transcripts), dictation polish, Rewind semantic-search embeddings, and web search, all of which fail closed with a clear log line or tool message under Local until you opt in, after which they are sent to Omi's servers and metered like any other provider. Reworked the free-plan paywall to be reason-aware: chat and push-to-talk are exempt whenever Local is active (the completion itself is always local), transcription stays exempt only with a self-hosted backend configured, and screen-capture-driven proactive features are exempt only while cloud-assisted features are off. Fixed the context-director notification pipeline to use the same Local exemption as screen capture instead of the raw BYOK-only paywall flag, so a stale trial flag can no longer silently swallow a notification the local model generated
